title: Essex Gas Company files for approval by the Department of Telecommunications and Energy a 365 Day Firm Transportation Agreement with Haverhill Paperboard Company.
petitioner: Essex Gas Company D/B/A National Grid
filings: Essex Gas Company's response to the First Set of Data and Information Request of the Attorney General. By: thomas P. O'Neil. GC 00-02

The Department APPROVES the proposed Agreement. The Department finds that the pricing terms of the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore GRANTS the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Commissioners Paul B. Vasington, Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr., James Connelly and W. Robert Keating. GC00-02.
Attorney General's First Set of Information Requests. By John M.Grugan. GC 00-02
